title: I've Decided to Change My Life

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've decided to make some serious changes this semester. I keep putting things off and I'm tired of it.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: What kind of changes? Are you planning to be more organised?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Exactly. I've started using a weekly planner. I enjoy ticking things off a list — it feels productive.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: That's great. I love making lists too, but I tend to forget checking them.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Ha! I've been practising checking mine every morning. Also — I've decided to stop checking my phone in the evenings.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Seriously? That's hard. Do you miss scrolling through things?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: A bit. But I've started reading instead. I'd forgotten how much I enjoy reading before bed.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: A biography of Abai. It's incredible. I can't imagine having been that creative in such difficult circumstances.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'd love to read that. Can you lend it to me when you finish?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Of course. I expect to finish it by the weekend. Also — I've promised myself to exercise three times a week.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: So you've decided to exercise, to stop using your phone in the evenings, and to use a planner. That's a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I know. But I've been avoiding making changes for too long. I refuse to keep drifting.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I admire that. I've been meaning to change a few things too. Maybe we can help each other stay on track.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Definitely. Let's agree to check in every Monday morning.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Agreed. I look forward to seeing the new organised Rustam.
